After transmigrating into a tragic danmei novel, Xie Chiyuan finds himself in the role of the great villain. In the original story, he is hopelessly obsessed with the protagonist, kidnapping him to the Demon Palace in a desperate attempt to force him to become his empress. Xie Chiyuan considers the protagonist’s reputation as the world’s greatest beauty and looks at his own status as a powerful Demon Lord. Deciding he is only missing a beautiful consort, he chooses to stick to the original plot. However, Xie Chiyuan forgot one crucial detail: he suffers from severe face blindness. Following the original script, he sets out to capture the protagonist. The first time, at the foot of a mountain, he accidentally kidnaps the protagonist’s cold and stern senior brother and forces him into wedding robes. The second time, at a teahouse, he mistakenly snatches the protagonist’s frail confidant and dresses him for a wedding. The third time, on the battlefield between immortals and demons, he captures the protagonist’s arch-rival and puts him in a bridal veil. By the fourth attempt, Xie Chiyuan finally manages to capture the actual protagonist. The elegant and refined hero, having reached his breaking point, snaps at him: “I thought you were supposed to be obsessed with me?” A month later, a deeply reflective Xie Chiyuan decides he no longer wants a beauty and resolves to be a serious, aloof Demon Lord. To his surprise, the men he kidnapped by mistake are suddenly unwilling to let him go. Format your description nicely so people can easily read them. Please use proper spacing and paragraphs. I ended up possessing a character in an SF novel I had only ever heard the title of. All I did was play a web game based on the novel’s setting. In that game, I meant to enjoy for just a moment, I happened to draw a legendary-grade hero with a 0.1 percent chance, Nael de Azani, and somehow ended up living as that very man. I didn’t know the original story, and I didn’t want to shoulder the heavy responsibilities of an imperial chancellor, so I planned to retire and live peacefully and comfortably as a wealthy, retired marshal… But things in this world did not go smoothly. Because of unexpected turmoil, I could no longer avoid Nael de Azani’s duties. To resolve this chaos, I needed the support of the imperial marshals. The man the Empire needed most for its stability, Antigonos Kranaha. When I asked him to work with me, he made an unexpected demand…. “Please, Admiral Kranaha. I know very well that you do not think highly of me, but for the sake of the Empire’s peace, I ask for your strength.” “Come closer.” Kranaha demanded in a low, heavy voice. Nael stepped in front of him as requested. The next moment, Kranaha suddenly took Nael’s hand. Right hand to left, left hand to right. “I understand the gist of what you’re trying to say. Knowing is one thing, but it doesn’t exactly move my heart. Would it kill you to show me a bit more sincerity?” “What more do you expect me to do here? Speak, Admiral Kranaha.” “I don’t like beating around the bush, so I’ll say it directly.” Kranaha tightened his grip and spoke bluntly. “Come into my bed, Azani.” * * * Chaos has come to the Empire where glory had been promised. Whose fault is it? After an accidental death, Qin Yunzhi transmigrates into a novel he once read, becoming the arch-nemesis of the story’s villain. His rival, Qi Zhao, is a master of disguise: in public, he acts like a pitiable underdog anyone can bully; in private, he is a ruthless man who settles every grudge. In the novel’s original ending, Qi Zhao went mad at the protagonists’ wedding and scarred the “Protagonist Shou’s” face, causing the latter to flee the country and meet a tragic end by being crushed by a falling rock. The System tells Qin Yunzhi: if he wants to be resurrected, he must save this collapsing world by changing Qi Zhao and ensuring he never attacks the protagonist. Qin Yunzhi: “…So, I’ve been handed the Savior’s script?” Qi Zhao had been loathed by everyone since childhood. He never expected that one day, someone would appear who didn’t hate him, but instead helped him walk out of the shadows. When Qi Zhao accidentally discovers his world is just a novel, he is left with only one thought: Grip Qin Yunzhi’s hand and never let go. In this fake world, Qin Yunzhi is the only thing that matters. After completing his mission, Qin Yunzhi returns to his original world to live a happy life with his resurrected parents. However, in his quiet moments, his thoughts often drift to Qi Zhao. System: 【Host, long time no see.】 Qin Yunzhi flinches at the sudden voice. The System takes human form and tearfully clings to his leg: 【It’s over! It’s all over! Qi Zhao has completely blackened. His influence has surpassed even the protagonist’s!】 Looking at the snot-faced System with disgust, Qin Yunzhi pulls his leg away. “So… I’m going back?” The System stops crying instantly: 【Great! That’s exactly what I wanted to hear!】 Qin Yunzhi’s vision goes black. When he opens his eyes, he sees a matured Qi Zhao standing before him—while he himself is sitting on Qi Zhao’s lap, completely naked. I’m fine with coming back, but why are my clothes gone?! Qi Zhao wraps his arms around him, whispering into his ear: “You’re finally back. It turns out threatening the System is much more effective than threatening that so-called ‘protagonist.'” Associated Names One entry per line 穿成反派死对头后 Related Series N/A Recommendations N/A Recommendation Lists These are recommendation lists which contains After Transmigrating as the Villain’s Arch-nemesis . Format your description nicely so people can easily read them. Please use proper spacing and paragraphs. Wen Xushi ended up bound to a totally glitchy system called 2506. According to 2506, he has transmigrated into a novel as a “male character N”—an Omega pretending to be an Alpha. His ultimate fate? The imperial tyrant will order his entire clan’s execution, his family will go bankrupt, and he’ll drown in the ocean to become a wandering ghost. To stop this from happening, the system says he has to kill the future tyrant: the currently sickly Crown Prince, Yu Chi. Wen Xushi, who was raised strictly as an Alpha his whole life, felt like he was having a mental breakdown. But 2506 insisted: “Trust me, dear Host!” On his first day there, Wen Xushi found a stranded mermaid. First thought: this fish is ridiculously good-looking. Second thought: oh no, this fish is dying. The books always say you shouldn’t pick up random men off the street, and the same rule applies to fish. So, being polite, he asked the dying creature: “Do you prefer to be steamed, braised, or… made into soup?” The fish just stared at him. Two seconds later, it spoke: “Brother, it hurts.” 2506 chimed in immediately: “Scan complete. This fish is not the tyrant.” So, Wen Xushi asked again: “What’s your name?” The fish looked down and said softly: “A-Chi.” Perfect! “A-Chi” (sounding like “The Pond”). Wen Xushi decided to keep this precious mermaid. The fish turned out to be high-maintenance—fussy, picky about food, and hard to serve—but he was super well-behaved! (The servants, however, would just smile through gritted teeth when they heard how “well-behaved” he supposedly was.) One day, Wen Xushi’s true gender was accidentally exposed. That “good little fish” suddenly grew legs overnight—very white, very long, very beautiful legs. But then… the fish bit him! Later, the Royal Secret Guards caught the scent of pheromones on Wen Xushi. They rushed to his door in a massive lineup, shouting: “We welcome the Crown Prince back to the palace!” Wen Xushi panicked. He immediately packed Yu Chi up to be sent away, screaming at the system: “2506, you’ve got some nerve! You’re trying to kill me!” 2506 just whimpered: “Ugh… your little system baby had a tiny bug.” That night, a devastated Wen Xushi went out to drink his sorrows away. In the darkness, a hand wearing a black half-finger glove covered his eyes from behind, and he was pulled into a firm embrace. The familiar scent of agarwood mixed with sweet and sour plum wine—the pheromones of a high-level Alpha—hit him instantly. Wen Xushi froze, only to hear the Alpha say: “Brother, I’m hurt…” No one knew that the sickly Crown Prince, who had never appeared in public, was actually a merman. Yu Chi had been ambushed during his debut, shot, and fell into the sea, eventually washing up on a deserted shore. Right as he was at death’s door, he met a person. But the first thing that person said to him was: “Do you prefer to be steamed, braised, or… made into soup?” Associated Names One entry per line 貌美人魚是個alpha 貌美人鱼是个alpha Related Series N/A Recommendations N/A Recommendation Lists These are recommendation lists which contains Beautiful Mermaid is an Alpha .
